queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tradereg) AS cnt
  FROM transactionrecord r
  JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
)
SELECT tradekind,
       cnt,
       cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share,
       cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS diff_from_avg
FROM c
WHERE cnt > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c)
SELECT tradekind, AVG(acctbal) AS avg_acctbal, SUM(acctbal) AS total_acctbal
FROM trader
WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY tradekind;
SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trader_count
FROM trader
GROUP BY tradekind;
SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT k.tradekind, COUNT(m.tradereg) AS cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tradekind FROM trader WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL) k LEFT JOIN trader m ON m.tradekind = k.tradekind AND m.freqscope = 'High' GROUP BY k.tradekind);
SELECT tradekind, AVG(acctbal) AS avg_acctbal
FROM trader
WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY tradekind;
